revision_history.note: First-author: Discovery Context drafted from a single stakeholder Q&A round (Admin/Delivery Agent/End User roles, Phase 1 = COD-only online ordering + delivery). Short hash: dHDeNRO6uU.

Resolved all 11 open questions into Decisions (decision-01..11) after a follow-up Q&A round: service area, dispatch, COD refusal, fee tiers, walk-in sales, catalog import, launch volume, regulatory scope, COD verification, stale-order stock release, Phase 2 deferral. Short hash: ubvlik25zj.

First-author: Vision drafted from stage 00 Discovery Context plus 2 follow-up questions (out-of-scope confirmation, handoff definition). Adds the one-deep-module depth claim (decision-12/13/14) and 9 new open questions for BRD. Short hash: 1SU4FR5Rur.

Resolved all 9 open questions into Decisions (decision-15..23) after a follow-up Q&A round: account model, cancellation window, notifications, catalog structure, tax, agent onboarding, language, admin access, mid-delivery reassignment. Short hash: tenH976IpK.

Percolated change (no module exists yet, so /daksh change's module-scoped script doesn't apply per its documented boundary gap -- hand-percolated instead): decision-15 revised from phone+SMS-OTP to email+OTP for End User login, on cost grounds; phone number retained as a plain checkout field for delivery-agent contact only. Raised by Bhargav during /daksh brd intake. Short hash: l7dzj2fsDz.

Manually restored status to approved after CR-001 resolved: approve.py's approve_cr() failed to auto-restore this stage because find_stage_for_doc() compares CR touched_docs (forward-slash, e.g. 'docs/business-requirements.md') against stage.output (also forward-slash) using str(Path(p)), which on Windows renders backslash -- same path-separator bug as elsewhere in this toolchain, this time inside CR resolution. Fixed doc_hash to the actual post-approval-block hash and added both PTL and Client approval entries by hand.

First-author: BRD drafted from vision.md -- 11 use cases, 28 FRs each tracing to one UC, 28 matching ACs, 5 NFRs, core data model, and a new domain-glossary.md locking the canonical order-status vocabulary. 6 open questions for stage 30. Short hash: w0k9wfHA32.

Resolved all 6 open questions into Decisions (decision-27..32) after a follow-up Q&A round: agent auth (email+OTP), OTP timing (10min/60s), admin password reset, multi-address support, server-side cart persistence, no order-size cap. Data model extended with AdminAccount, Cart, CartLine. Short hash: ZFjhr8U6DX.
CR-001: added deactivated status for previously-approved Delivery Agents (FR-029/AC-029), discovered while scoping AUTH's Solution spec. domain-glossary.md updated to match. Short hash: aQXyLSOSLn.

Manifest surgery ahead of first-authoring: renamed modules INVENTORY->CATALOG and BILLING->ORDERS (AUTH unchanged) to match the real module boundaries the BRD's 11 use cases implied, which weren't known at /daksh init. Directories git mv'd; module_config and all 30c/30d/50a/50b/50c/50d stage keys and output paths updated to match. No content existed under the old names to migrate.

First-author: Architecture drafted from BRD/vision/client-context. Monolithic FastAPI backend (CATALOG/ORDERS/AUTH packages), Next.js frontend (3 role-scoped view groups), Postgres 16, JWT sessions, SQLAlchemy+Alembic. 6 decisions (33-38), 6 open questions (27-32, mostly hosting-target-dependent). Short hash: 1Xmj0EqO6Q.

Resolved 5 of 6 open questions into Decisions (decision-39..43): Resend for email, AWS S3 for storage, GitHub Actions for CI/CD, keep PREVIEW environment, daily/7-day DB backups. oq-27 (hosting target) remains genuinely open pending the client. Short hash: saFWidJkdh.

First-author: Roadmap drafted from architecture/BRD/vision. Dependency-driven build order AUTH->CATALOG->ORDERS (decision-45), Design stage selected for all 3 modules (decision-44), solo/AI-assisted capacity with no fixed sprints (decision-46). 5 milestones (2 new, 3 reused from BRD), 3 open questions. Short hash: CzFZJ5K9SK.

Resolved all 3 open questions after a follow-up round: no hard deadline (decision-46 re-confirmed, after a one-week date was raised, checked, and clarified as illustrative not real), CATALOG waits for AUTH (decision-47), Design fully closes before TRD (decision-48). Short hash: eaTt4iJw8t.

First-author: AUTH Solution drafted from BRD/vision/architecture. 5 business flows (SS-AUTH-001..005), 3 decisions (cross-role identity, OTP-every-login, admin no-MFA), 3 open questions (session lifetime, rate-limit threshold, deactivation-reassignment interaction). Short hash: xUU92aAJx8.

Resolved all 3 open questions after a follow-up round: 7-day session lifetime (decision-52), 5 OTP requests/hour/email rate limit (decision-53), agent deactivation auto-flags in-flight orders for manual reassignment rather than auto-reassigning or blocking (decision-54). Short hash: ZhKLGQDCvI.

First-author: AUTH System drafted from Solution/BRD/Architecture. 14 testable behaviors (SY-AUTH-001..014), 3 state machines (agent status, session, reset token), 6 data models, 3 logical interfaces, 3 decisions (reactivation allowed, single-use tokens, no hard-delete), resolved the deactivation cross-module data-flow risk (ORDERS reads AUTH, not pushed) to preserve the AUTH-first build order. 3 open questions (retention, self-deletion, audit trail). Short hash: cgunIlwAst.

Resolved all 3 open questions after a follow-up round: indefinite agent-record retention no auto-purge (decision-58), no End User self-deletion in Phase 1 (decision-59), append-only agent-status-change audit log added (decision-60, new dm-agent-status-log). Short hash: DlFabSGgZ5.

Short hash: Iq4ddwvB01.

Resolved oq-46/47/48 into decision-64/65/66 (OTP paste/autofill, agent photo upload, microcopy locked); updated prototype to add photo-upload field to ds-auth-004, no drift remaining. Short hash: 9T7PeR1jKQ.

Reformatted resolved Open Questions as prose bullets (not a numbered list) so the approval gate's open-question counter reads them as resolved, not pending. Short hash: sTjbSDpJHK.
